decisions.reason: Premium customer support is close to the established hosting and support offer, so it likely meets aspirations and is kept.
The version management tool builds on established software and may be integrated into the platform; slack allows keeping while search continues.
The data-processing contract tool is distant from the established hosting offer and likely underperforms relative to aspirations, triggering problemistic search and likely removal.
Scalable hosting for agencies is central to the firm's strategy and close to its core, likely meeting or exceeding aspirations, so it is retained.
